list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(data+ml): finalize dimuon ETL, feature set, spark partitions and anomaly scoring
Data Engineering: - structured data lake: raw → processed → features → spark partitions - saved processed dataset to parquet - generated partitioned layout event_type=dimuon/energy=7
Feature Engineering: - selected 11 physics-informed features for ML - exported ML-ready feature set to parquet
ML / Anomaly Detection: - trained autoencoder on dimuon feature space - computed anomaly_score and anomaly_label - visualized mass spectrum (normal vs anomaly)
Output: - saved final anomaly results parquet - code structured for next stage: anomaly analysis & model refinement

feat: build initial data processing pipeline and create Spark-ready data lake
Details:
Added raw CSV ingestion and created a cleaned processed dataset (dimuon_processed.parquet)
Performed feature engineering and generated ML-ready feature set (dimuon_features.parquet)
Implemented directory structure for project (data/raw, data/processed, data/features, docs, notebooks)
Created Spark-compatible partitioned data lake
spark/event_type=dimuon/energy=7/part-0000.parquet
Added exploratory analysis notebook with invariant mass histogram (J/ψ and Z peaks visible)
Prepared dataset for downstream ML anomaly detection and streaming pipeline
